## Security Checklist

<!-- Mark the relevant option(s) with an "x". -->

- [ ] No secrets, credentials, tokens, or API keys are logged, persisted, or transmitted.
- [ ] No sensitive data is written to logs, error messages, or telemetry.
- [ ] Content Security Policy (CSP) remains intact and has not been weakened.
- [ ] No new external dependencies introduce known vulnerabilities.
- [ ] Input validation and output encoding are applied to untrusted data.
- [ ] Authentication and authorization checks are preserved and correctly enforced.
- [ ] No use of unsafe APIs (e.g., `eval`, `innerHTML`, `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`) without justification.
- [ ] Changes have been reviewed for potential injection, XSS, CSRF, and SSRF risks.
